summary.zh: 在 DSH Go 内置的 Ubuntu 环境里安装 magpie，默认起网关 + 网页版；面板可看状态、切换启动方式、配置端口与安装代理，安装与运行状态都进日志。
summary.en: Installs magpie inside DSH Go's built-in Ubuntu environment and runs the gateway plus web console by default; the panel shows status, start mode, ports, install proxy, live install logs and a status check.
